### Statistics by age group

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

print_likert_items(
  df,
  likert_cols,
  meta = cols,
  group_by = "age_group",

  heading_level = 4L,
  levels = response_levels,
  empty_message = "No responses available for United Kingdom in the current filter."
)
```
